faqs.question: Can 🐺🌕 be used for sympathy?
faqs.answer: Yes — 🐺🌕 works for sympathy-coded moments when the partner emoji is a heart or a tear. For heavier grief, prefer a sentence.

faqs.question: What does 🐺🌕 mean if I cannot meet up?
faqs.answer: When 🐺🌕 is sent in a missed-meeting context, the combo reads as a soft-coded "I wish I was there." It lands tender-coded rather than accusatory.

faqs.question: How do I make 🐺🌕 land sincerely?
faqs.answer: Pair 🐺🌕 with a sentence that names the feeling. Pure emoji replies read lower-effort than text plus emoji.

faqs.question: Does 🐺🌕 work in a family group?
faqs.answer: Yes — 🐺🌕 travels well in family-coded groups when the recipient already reads the emotion-coded register.
